tagline: Drop your event photos in, add a few notes, and let the AI arrange them into a story. Pick a format, hit render — the same polished WSTI look, every time.
voice:
WSTI (Western Sydney Tech Innovators) is Western Sydney's most vibrant community for AI, emerging tech and innovation — 3,400+ members strong, grassroots, volunteer-run, based around Parramatta. Founder Lailei Huang's ethos: "sometimes you've got to create what you want to be part of." Flagship: the AI Shed — hands-on learning, skills training, and access to resources to prepare Western Sydney for the jobs and industries of the future. Cadence: weekly AI Lab Sessions, casual community hangouts, bootcamps, workshops, mentorship, the Young AI Engineers Club. Themes: equitable AI adoption, no-one-left-behind, community-led innovation, accessibility and inclusion, local pride. 

VOICE: warm, human, energetic and inclusive — proud of its people, never corporate or stiff. Celebrates faces, hands-on building, and Western Sydney pride. Likes phrases like "hands-on", "come and learn", "build with us", "accessible and inclusive", "the best is still to come". Avoid: jargon, hype words like "unlock" / "revolutionise", title-case ad headlines, generic stock copy.

GOOD EXAMPLES (the kind of tone we want): "From AI lab sessions with hands-on learning to casual hangouts discussing what's happening in the tech scene — WSTI is creating an accessible and inclusive environment where anyone can get involved." / "How can we harness the power of AI to empower the community while ensuring no one is left behind?"
